Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
From activities
Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid
Left Join compound_structures on activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Where activities.standard_relation = '='
  and activities.pchembl_value is not null
  and activities.bao_endpoint = 'IC50'
  and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795176'
  and target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  and target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606
Order by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
Limit 1000
